physical_skill: Turn two eye bolts on opposite sides of a stand in opposite directions by matched amounts (about 3.5 turns each of a 1.41 mm thread, pinching each eye and rolling the wrist, regripping every half turn) so the caged trunk moves from a 2.5 degree lean to within 1 degree of plumb with all three caps still bearing.
valid_shortcuts: Backing B out first, then screwing A in (sequential, one bolt at a time) is valid and scores 1.0 if the end state is met.
One arm turning both bolts with other grips is valid if reachable; not exercised.
Pushing the trunk by hand: blocked by the caps (red team push 0.0).
Screwing A alone jams (onearm 0.0); backing B alone leaves the lean (careless 0.0); backing A out lets the tree flop (wrongway 0.0, harm).
distinct_from_nearest: No accepted or pending PR straightens a Christmas tree or adjusts a tree stand; the nearest skill matches (#2379, #2392) were specialist instrument levelling closed on importance.
